'''Redeemed Revan's Lightsaber''' was the personal weapon of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] toward the end of his life.

==History==
Following [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]'s failed [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|attempt]] to kill the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] became the Emperor's captive,<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> imprisoned in stasis for three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] became aware of his imprisonment due to the intervention of [[Meetra Surik]]'s [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], which had stayed beside Revan the entire time. A Republic strike team was sent to [[Taral V]] in order to gain access a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] in order to navigate a route through the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom Nebula]]. They succeeded in freeing Revan.

The [[Color/Legends|violet]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] traveled with its master to the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]], a massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located within an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], which allowed it to create massive amounts of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in a short period of time. Revan would once again use his lightsaber to fight against an Imperial strike force commanded by [[Darth Malgus]], who ordered the capture of the station, and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Revan to boot. In a fierce fight, Revan appeared to have lost, but he disappeared in a flash of light before the death blow could be struck.<ref name="Foundry" />

After returning to lead the [[Order of Revan]] which bore his name, the blade remained with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] fueled warrior until he fell for the last time to the [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]] strike team led by Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post-Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces. Upon merging with his [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] self and becoming whole once more, the lightsaber was left behind along with his iconic [[Revan's mask|mask]] and robes.<ref name="Shadow">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jedi_Knight_Revan_Event-SWGoH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|"Jedi Knight Revan" wields a different lightsaber in ''Galaxy of Heroes'']]
This lightsaber was depicted for the first time in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Foundry" /> a video game developed by [[BioWare]] and released in [[2011]].<ref name="SWTOR Release">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref> In [[2020]], the lightsaber was released on ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' [[Cartel Market]], where it was identified with the name "Redeemed Revan's Lightsaber".<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20201209-0|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 6.2}}</ref> For ''The Old Republic'', the lightsaber was designed by [[Tanner Hartman]] under the supervision of lead MTX artist [[Bradley W. Lewis]] and art director [[Carrie Meade]].<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=htannerhartman|url=artwork/xJ2ED2|name=[[Tanner Hartman]]|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic - Redeemed Revan's Lightsaber [IRAY Render]}}</ref>

In [[2019]],<ref name="SWGOH Date 2">{{EASWYouTube|VSdNf177m0o|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes — The Scourge of the Old Republic}}</ref> the character "Darth Revan" was added to the video game ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'', where he would wield this lightsaber, with an incoherent depiction: it would display four lateral ridges instead of three. Previously, another version of the character, in the form of "Jedi Knight Revan,"<ref name="SWGOH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref> released in [[2018]] within ''Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes'',<ref name="SWGOH Date 1">{{EASWYouTube|KMi8RBCQv9E|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes - Legend of the Old Republic}}</ref> is seen using [[Fallen Revan's Lightsaber|another lightsaber]],<ref name="SWGOH" /> the blade usually associated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] persona of the character, while the saber used by the "Darth Revan" version of the character is usually associated with his post-Sith persona.<ref name="SWTOR" />
